This file is the public claim cover for Ra-Thor / Rathor.ai after the July–September 2026 employ, wrap, and copy work. It does not rewrite the July architecture essay.

July record (historical): docs/archive/root-releases/WHITEPAPER_v4.1.md.

If this cover and v4.1 disagree, this cover and the claim lock win.

Why v4.2 exists #

v4.1 (22 July 2026) is a real architecture snapshot. It is also stale as a living public paper. Since July the lattice shipped a stranger employ spine, a wrap kit, a public-voice split, AG-SML v1.2 as the living grant, and a locked claim ceiling. Leaving v4.1 as the only “primary paper” asks strangers to treat SURMISE sentences as current product fact.

A 13 September council minute said: do not mint v4.2 in a link-fix slice. That slice is closed. This cover is the next bounded paper motion — not a new 12-section cosmology.

Sentences in v4.1 that are retired as living claims #

Keep the July file. Do not quote these as present tense without the cover:

  1. “AGSi demonstrated” by sole-operator Powrush-MMO completion in ≈30–50 days. Living rule: Combined AGSi stays SURMISE. Powrush-MMO is a separate repo and is not sold as finished from this lattice.
  2. AG-SML v1.0 as the living grant. Living grant is v1.2. The 31 August work pack that cited v1.0 is a draft freeze, not the current license stamp.
  3. Workspace “14.15.x (July 2026)” as the public identity string. Public identity is 14.15.6.
  4. “Production-grade” self-evolution cascade as a shipping product. Self-evolution remains research forest, not the public offer.
  5. Any reading of v4.1 that implies an xAI partnership, a METR lab, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act conformance, or a hosted rathor.ai key proxy.

What actually landed after v4.1 (the reason a cover is due) #

These are inspectable artifacts, not new miracles:

  • Stranger employ spine: docs/EMPLOY.md + /employ.html
  • Public briefing (visitor voice): docs/PUBLIC_EMPLOY_BRIEFING.md + /briefing.html
  • Optional-model contract: docs/OPTIONAL_MODEL.md
  • Wrap kit: docs/ADOPT.md, wrappers/system-prompt.txt, per-model snippets, wrappers/local-shim/rathor_wrap.py (JSON + SSE, operator-held keys)
  • Public / operator voice split: HOLD lines stay in operator docs; they do not print on the site
  • Claim lock and employ lock tests as merge hygiene
  • Living license stamp AG-SML v1.2

That is enough delta to justify a cover version. It is not enough delta to justify rewriting v4.1’s architecture body in one seat.

How to read the stack #

  1. This cover + PUBLIC_CLAIM.lock.md — what you may say in public.
  2. docs/EMPLOY.md and /employ.html — how to employ.
  3. docs/ADOPT.md — how to wrap Grok / Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini / Cursor / a local server.
  4. docs/archive/root-releases/WHITEPAPER_v4.1.md — July architecture essay, with the retired sentences above marked historical.
  5. Default Cargo members only. Named cargo test -p. A full workspace run is not the product gate.

Honest gaps (unchanged) #

No measured METR numbers. No cert filing. The 31 August 2026 work pack is a draft. Combined AGSi remains SURMISE. Site chrome translations are not sold as complete offline packs.
